whatWasDone: The three cases lost their Explicit declaration and received real measurement barriers: every snapshot is now preceded by WaitForMeasurementsAsync bound to the harness cancellation token instead of being taken immediately after the consumed signal.
isolatedResult: Each of the three passes alone in about half a second.
combinedResult: Run together, the first one passes and the other two fail. Run together with Introspection_Specs, which starts a bus earlier, two of three fail again.

facts: _isConfigured is a process wide static latch set in Configure at line 481.
_meter and every counter are static fields that belong to the meter of whichever provider configured first.
TryConfigure(IServiceProvider) returns immediately when the latch is already set, so a later container never creates its own instruments.
A MetricCollector created from a later provider's IMeterFactory is scoped to that factory and therefore observes nothing.
provenCause.consequence: In an unfiltered run the owner of the latch is whichever fixture starts a bus first. These three cases can only observe measurements when their own provider happens to own it.

whyNoTestSideFix: There is no public way to obtain the configured meter or to reset the latch. MetricCollector can bind to a scope, a meter or an instrument; the meter and the instruments are private static, and the scope of the configured meter belongs to a foreign provider. Ordering the fixture first would be a filter, not a proof.
notAProductChangeYet: No product file is touched. The finding is reported before any change, as directive 0025 and 0027 require.
restOfBlock1a: The other seven declarations of this block lost their Explicit declaration and are green: RedeliveryHeader, OrCanceled, UncorrelatedMessage, SendEndpointCache, Batch and the three RequestClient fixtures.
